name: Henri
source: Henri is a French-Canadian chef who trained at several renown and famous culinary schools across the world. once a sous-chef for the great chef David Adjey, Henri wanted to move on to a more quieter line of work while still being able to express his culinary skills creatively. He found his way to Brooks and was hired on the spot. Henri is a very shameless, sexual person that does very little to hide his preferences. His relationships are often short and frequent, tending to suit his mood at the time.
